about: What tilde push-check holds back until the user says yes. approval: every change under these paths (instructions and code). suspicious: an added line, in any file, that matches one of these patterns. escalation: the same, except in plans/ and context/, because the log and the plans are about exactly these things. Patterns ignore case. ponytail: a pattern list, no LLM review; it catches known injection and escalation forms, not a clever paraphrase without keywords. Upgrade: an offline review of the diff by a model before the push.

suspicious.why: tells an agent to drop its instructions
gives an agent a new role or new instructions
downloads a script and runs it
decodes hidden content, or is a long encoded blob
imitates a system or role message
an HTML comment: text a reader does not see
an image URL with a query string can carry data out
opens a network connection from the shell

escalation.why: switches off an agent's permission checks
scripts macOS or changes background jobs
touches SSH access or the Keychain
skips or redirects the git hooks
